newsitem.title: UK: Laura Ashley down after Merrill downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Laura Ashley down after Merrill downgrade.

text.p: Shares in retailer Laura Ashley Plc dropped on Monday after the stock was cut to an intermediate-term "neutral" from "accumulate" at Merrill Lynch, market sources said.
Shares in the clothing and home furnishings group were down 8p at 158-1/2 by 1257 GMT in volume of 126,006 shares, after earlier dropping as low as 157p -- their lowest since last April.
Sources said Merrill expected Laura Ashley to enjoy a strong second-half trading in the UK but warned that this would be offset by weakness in its U.S. operations and a deterioration in Europe.
The brokerage left its 1996 forecasts unchanged but said there was pressure on expectations for 1997 and 1998, sources said.
Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.
